title: Variant build result
description: What a video-builder returns for ONE variant, written to workspace/concepts/<concept>/<letter>/result.json before it answers. The reviewer reads this, not the chat message.

checks.description: Measured, not asserted. Every field comes from a command you actually ran; the reviewer re-runs them and a lie here is a blocker.

audio_duration_s.description: Has to match the video's, or the ending goes silent.

strip.description: The fps=2,tile=12x6 strip you LOOKED at. Without it, nobody looked.

builder.description: build.py that regenerates the spec and the pre-renders FROM SCRATCH. A spec pointing at a temporary you already deleted is not reproducible.

preview.description: -preview.mp4 with the song, for listening only.

cuts_with_subject.description: Counted by hand. cuts_with_subject / cuts is checked against the concept's subject_quota.

moments.description: Catalog ids used. Every one exists, and no cut steps outside its start_s/end_s window.

out_of_window.description: Ids whose window you had to widen, with the strip you looked at first. Empty is the normal answer.

voice_script.description: voice-script.json (schemas/voice-script.schema.json) when narrated is true. It ships next to the MP4 even when the voice is already baked in.

voice_engine.description: Which engine produced the WAVs, or '' when the variant ships without voice.

notes.description: Decisions you took and what did not come out the way you wanted.

warnings.description: Anything you could not do and worked around: a missing dependency, a voice that never generated, a range that had to be trimmed. Silence here reads as 'everything worked'.
